+title: 'R1: size the prompt-cache byte budget from the pool and give it to the fork'
+---
+## Why
+
+The user decided on 2026-09-24: the prompt-cache limit is memory in BYTES, not a number of sessions. `ExecutorPromptCacheStore.maximumRetainedSessions = 4` (fork, `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCache.swift:99`) goes away. An entry that does not fit in RAM goes to disk. The budget comes from the Router, because several models can be resident together. Full plan: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-wballard-github-swissarmyhammer-FoundationModelsAgents/12caa688-1fd0-482f-9b0f-7447b7cdf19b/scratchpad/prompt-cache-memory-and-disk-plan.md`.
+
+This task replaces the "limit setting" part of ^3r4rsrz.
+
+## External dependency
+
+Fork task F2 (`configure(memoryBudgetBytes:)`) on the mlx-swift-lm board. Do not start until F2 is merged on the fork's `stable` branch.
+
+## What to do
+
+1. Compute the budget: `HostProfile.recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize` minus the sum of `PoolEntry.footprintBytes` (`Resolution/ModelPool.swift:66`: weights plus `acquiredChargeBytes`).
+   - Checked 2026-09-24: `acquiredChargeBytes` is one KV estimate for each SLOT hold (`ModelPool.swift:233-246`, `:327`), not for each session. Many sessions share one hold. Thus the charge covers the pass in flight, and the retained caches of other sessions need this budget. There is no double count.
+2. Call `configure(memoryBudgetBytes:)` when a model loads, and again when a model loads or unloads (the pool insert and evict paths).
+3. The store is process-wide (`ExecutorPromptCacheStore.shared`). If more than one pool can exist in one process, write down how their budgets combine.
+4. Write in a doc comment that `Footprint` (`Sizing/Footprint.swift:68-79`) does not size recurrent state (Mamba/SSM).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A unit test of the budget computation, with 0, 1, and 2 resident models.
+- [ ] The budget is sent again after a load and after an unload (test with a recording double).
+- [ ] An integration test (gated) with two resident models: weights plus caches stay within the pool budget. #generation-queue #prompt-cache
\ No newline at end of file
